question.question: How do Maker bonus spice, the Shield Wall and Maker Hooks affect harvesting and summoning, and where can a sandworm be placed?

key.expected_answer: Makers phase adds one bonus spice on each unoccupied Maker space, accumulating; visiting collects all bonus spice. Shield Wall blocks worms at Arrakeen, Spice Refinery, Imperial Basin until removed to box. Maker Hooks prerequisite when specified; summoning directly bank to Conflict, never garrison.

response.answer: At Makers, each unoccupied Maker space gains one spice on its bonus spot; when visited, you gain all accumulated bonus spice. Deep Desert costs 3 water and offers 4 base spice or, with Hooks, two worms; Hagga Basin costs 1 water and offers 2 base spice or, with Hooks, one worm. Hooks are required only where specified and are retained, not spent. The Shield Wall prevents summoning at Arrakeen, Spice Refinery, or Imperial Basin while present; once removed, worms may be summoned to any Conflict. A worm can never go into a garrison.
response.evidence: Makers: unoccupied spaces add spice; ‘gain all’ bonus; Sandworms and Shield Wall sections give restrictions and choices.

question.question: When can Plot, Combat and Endgame Intrigues be played, how are unplayed Intrigues kept and ordinary ones discarded, and what if the Intrigue deck is exhausted?

key.expected_answer: Plot during own Agent/Reveal turns, Combat during Combat with a unit, Endgame at game end. Unplayed face down separate from deck, owner may inspect; played resolved cards face up Intrigue discard. Exhaustion reshuffles Intrigue discard into new deck.
key.source_references: Main p7 / extraction 345–354; FAQ p2 Intrigue cards

response.answer: Plot Intrigues may be played during your own Agent or Reveal turns; Combat Intrigues only during Combat; Endgame Intrigues at game end. Keep unplayed Intrigues face down and separate from your deck; after resolving, put them face up in the Intrigue discard pile. If the deck runs out, shuffle its discard pile into a new deck.
response.evidence: Intrigue cards section and FAQ Draw timing: types/timing, face-down separate, face-up discard; exhausted deck is reshuffled.

question.question: State Accept Contract and Dutiful Service’s Agent icons and effects with and without CHOAM, and whether both automatically advance a Faction track.

key.expected_answer: Accept Contract: Spice Trade, draw card plus contract or 2 Solari, no automatic Faction Influence. Dutiful Service: Emperor, one Emperor Influence plus contract or 2 Solari. Contract fallback if module off or all contracts taken.

response.answer: Accept Contract uses Spice Trade access; it always draws one card and gives a contract with CHOAM, otherwise 2 Solari (also 2 Solari if contracts are exhausted). Dutiful Service uses Emperor access; it gives one Emperor Influence and a contract with CHOAM, otherwise 2 Solari. Accept Contract has no automatic Faction advance; Dutiful Service automatically advances Emperor Influence by one, counted once total.
response.evidence: Board Space Guide and Faction status: Accept Contract non-Faction, Dutiful Service Emperor; table lists their effects.

question.question: State Accept Contract and Dutiful Service’s Agent icons and effects with and without CHOAM, and whether both automatically advance a Faction track.

key.expected_answer: Accept Contract: Spice Trade, draw card plus contract or 2 Solari, no automatic Faction Influence. Dutiful Service: Emperor, one Emperor Influence plus contract or 2 Solari. Contract fallback if module off or all contracts taken.

response.answer: Accept Contract uses the Spice Trade icon, has no cost, and always draws one card; with CHOAM it also takes a contract, while without CHOAM—or when no contracts remain—it gives 2 Solari instead. Dutiful Service uses the Emperor icon, has no cost, gains 1 Emperor Influence, and likewise takes a contract with CHOAM or 2 Solari without it/when none remain. Accept Contract is not a Faction and gives no automatic Influence; Dutiful Service gives one Emperor Influence once total (its listed effect is the same as the Faction advance, not an extra one).
response.evidence: Board guide: Accept Contract is Spice Trade, no cost, always draw; CHOAM contract/otherwise 2 Solari. Dutiful Service is Emperor, gains 1 Emperor Influence and contract/otherwise 2 Solari. Faction clarification: Accept is non-Faction; Dutiful's one Influence counted once.
